# AshFall phase 7 blocklist (docs/phase7.md)
#
# One entry per line. Comments and blank lines are ignored.
#
#   module  <Soong/make module>   must not appear as /<module>/ or /<module>.apex
#                                 in installed-files.txt
#   path    <absolute path>       must not appear in installed-files.txt
#   package <Android package>     must not be installed on the device
#
# Keep the module list in sync with aosp/vendor/ashfall/debloat.mk.
